headline: Run Claude Code From Your Phone With Replit
lede: A brief guide by @mattyp shows how to run **Claude Code** — Anthropic's terminal-based agentic coding tool — on a mobile phone in under five minutes using Replit's cloud environment. The trick is straightforward: because Replit runs entirely in a browser, it sidesteps the need for a desktop terminal. The screenshot in the post shows Claude Code v2.1.12 running on-device with the Opus 4.5 model under a Claude Max subscription.
body:
Claude Code was designed as a command-line tool that works inside a developer's local shell, which means it ordinarily has no native mobile experience. The workaround demonstrated here uses *Replit*, a browser-based cloud IDE that provisions a Linux container and exposes a full terminal. Because Replit runs in Safari or Chrome like any webpage, it functions on a phone's screen — cramped, but operational.

The setup requires two things the guide flags upfront: an Anthropic subscription or API key, and a free Replit account. Beyond that it is a matter of installing Claude Code inside the Replit workspace and launching it — the same `claude` command that developers use on a laptop. The screenshot confirms the experience looks identical to the desktop CLI, complete with the model selector and keyboard-shortcut prompt.

The image also shows a detail worth noting: the session advertises "3 guest passes at /passes," a Claude Code feature that lets a host share temporary access to their running session with collaborators. On a phone that detail is largely academic, but it hints at the fuller capability set available even in this stripped-down setup.

The appeal is situational rather than ergonomic. Typing long prompts on a phone keyboard remains uncomfortable, but for reviewing an agent's output, approving a file edit, or triggering a short task while away from a desk, the setup is genuinely useful. It converts a $20-per-month Claude Max subscription into something closer to ambient access rather than a desk-bound tool.

concepts.definition: Anthropic's agentic coding assistant that runs as a command-line tool inside a developer's terminal. It can read files, write code, run shell commands, and manage a codebase autonomously based on natural-language instructions. It is distinct from Claude's chat interface — it is built for sustained, multi-step engineering work.

A cloud-based development environment accessible through a web browser. It provisions a Linux container with a full terminal and code editor, so developers can write and run code without installing anything locally. Because it is browser-native, it works on phones and tablets as well as desktops.

Anthropic's higher-tier consumer subscription plan, which gives subscribers access to more powerful models (including Opus) and higher usage limits than the standard Claude Pro plan. It is the subscription tier used by the session shown in the screenshot.
